title: Degrees of Prolongation Varieties of Monomial Planar Systems
content: For the differential system x′1 = xp2, x′2 = xq1 with p, q ≥ 2 we compute the degree of every prolongation variety. It is a quadratic quasi-polynomial in the order of prolongation, with period lcm(p+1,q+1). This proves the two formulas proposed by Pogudin, gives the quasi-polynomial he asked for when (p,q)=(2,3), and proves Puddu's conjecture.
